{{Quote|That's Captain Ric Olié in ''Bravo One''. Battle-hardened at Chommell Minor.|Ars Veruna, pointing out ''Bravo 1'' to Senator Palpatine|<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''Chommell Minor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
Chommell Minor was the namesake of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]. It was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]], who would serve for a short time as the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] representative after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] election as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and, following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], become a member of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Inner Circle]].<ref name="DB" />

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] was battle-hardened at Chommell Minor.<ref name="DP" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] campaigned on the planet against the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_4.html|Stark Veterans Blast Amidala}}</ref>

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Some sources use an alternate spelling of '''''Chommel'''''. [[Leland Chee]] has stated that ''Chommell'' is the correct spelling.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=158725&start=97#11593602|thread=Spelling Discrepancies|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2005-06-27|time=10:12 AM}}</ref>
